mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods following low FEDFUNDS, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate suggests economic weakness, potentially leading to negative S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the periods when UNRATE exceeds 9%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales indicate positive consumer sentiment, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods following strong RSAFS, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Low industrial production may signal supply chain issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the periods when INDPRO is below 93, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment numbers indicate a robust economy, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods following strong PAYEMS, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in unemployment rate combined with a decrease in federal funds rate may indicate a specific policy response, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods when UNRATE increases and FEDFUNDS decreases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth combined with moderate inflation may indicate a balanced economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods when GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL indicate balanced growth, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts in a late-cycle expansion may indicate continued economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the periods when HOUST is high in a late-cycle expansion, the hypothesis is rejected.
